dex.text: Built itself a palace out of other people's money and a great many onion domes. Throws a banquet every night and gets up at noon.
dex.fact: The Royal Pavilion was rebuilt by John Nash from 1815 to 1823 for the Prince Regent, later George IV, nicknamed Prinny. Its onion domes, and the palm-tree columns in its kitchen, are held up by cast iron.
